What's the point of playing a table-top game on the computer? Why not just play a computer game?

You are always confined by the rules of the video game. In D&D I can just make up stuff on the spot.
A computer game, no matter its size, has a specific scenario (or set of scenarios) to play through. A tabletop game follows whatever scenario you can imagine. Playing it with friends is also a plus.
